references.text: Here God says that a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh, which reflects the unity and indivisibility of marriage mentioned in Matthew 19:6.
Paul warns against sexual immorality and reminds us that whoever is united with the Lord is one spirit with him, drawing parallels to being 'one flesh' in marriage.
Paul quotes Genesis 2:24 about a man leaving his father and mother and being joined to his wife, so that the two shall become one flesh, emphasizing the importance of marital unity.
